text:
Type: black-brown three-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes and linens, surface for lamps and decor; bedroom, living room, hallway
Style: minimalist, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: ash veneer stained black-brown with visible grain, fiberboard
Colors: dark black-brown, near-black
Shape: plain boxy cabinet with three wide flush drawers, handleless fronts with a top-edge grip recess, recessed plinth base, clean sharp edges, medium visual weight
Feel: sleek, sober, calm, solid
Goes with: white or light grey walls, light oak, brass or chrome accents; modern or minimalist bedrooms and living rooms

product.name: MALM
product.description: Can also be used as a bedside table.
